**[[Foreign involvement in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Foreign involvement in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Kenya]] reports at least 16 Kenyans are missing after being recruited to fight for the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] in [[Ukraine]], while 38 others are currently in [[List of hospitals in Russia|Russian hospitals]] in unknown conditions as they are under restricted access. '''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Air China]], [[China Southern Airlines]], and its subsidiary [[XiamenAir]] increase [[fuel surcharge]]s by [[Renminbi|¥]]60–120 ([[United States dollar|US$]]8.70–17.50) on domestic flights in response to rising [[Price of oil|oil prices]] linked to the Iran war. [https://www.thestandard.com.hk/world/article/328391/Chinese-airlines-to-raise-fuel-surcharges-on-domestic-flights (AFP via ''The Standard'')]

[https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2026/04/1409225/pakistan-hikes-petrol-diesel-prices-amid-mideast-war (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]
**[[United States]] [[Petroleum in the United States|crude oil]] surges to over [[United States dollar|$]]113 per [[Barrel (unit)|barrel]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/business/markets/oil-prices-stock-market-iran-war-trump-rcna266351 (NBC News)]
*The [[Ministry of Ports (Somalia)|Somali Ministry of Ports and Maritime Transport]] announces that [[Somalia]] has registered the Guney (IMO 8230417) ship under the [[Flag of Somalia|Somali flag]], its first national-flagged vessel since 1991. '''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Iran relations]]
**[[Argentina]] orders [[Iran]]ian [[chargé d'affaires]] Mohsen Soltani Tehrani to leave the country within 48 hours after Iranian officials issued statements that Argentina described as false and offensive. The move follows Argentina's designation of the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] as a [[Terrorism in Argentina|terrorist]] organization. [https://www.lbcgroup.tv/news/world-news/920881/argentina-expels-irans-diplomatic-envoy/en (AFP via LBCI)]
*[[Moldova–Russia relations]], [[Accession of Moldova to the European Union]]
**[[Moldova]]'s [[Parliament of Moldova|parliament]] approves the country's withdrawal from the [[Commonwealth of Independent States]] (CIS), as [[Government of Moldova|the government]] says CIS's core values and  principles are no longer respected, such as territorial integrity and the inviolability of borders, and refers to Russia's actions in the region, including the [[Russo-Ukrainian war|war against Ukraine]] and the [[Operational Group of Russian Forces|illegal military presence on Moldovan territory]]. [https://www.moldpres.md/eng/politics/parliament-votes-for-moldova-s-final-withdrawal-from-the-cis (Moldova Press)] [https://tass.com/world/2110711 (TASS)]

*[[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia]], [[Protests against the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Protests against the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**The [[Basmanny District Court]] in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]], sentences [[Germans|German]] sculptor [[Jacques Tilly]] [[Trial in absentia|in absentia]] to eight years and six months in [[Prisons in Russia|prison]] for spreading [[Disinformation in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|false information]] about [[Russian Armed Forces|the military]] and offending [[Religion in Russia|religious believers]] through his public works and statements concerning [[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russia's actions in Ukraine]].
